claim: For M>=1 prospectively fixed reset experiments and N>=1 independent bounded trials per experiment with true common expectations p(w), all empirical means have error at most sqrt(log(2M/delta)/(2N)) on one event of probability at least 1-delta. Coverage maps transfer that same event to H, every G_s and b0 with spectral bounds r*epsilon and Euclidean bound sqrt(r)*epsilon.
assumptions: Probability measure; finite nonempty experiment family W; positive trial count N; 0<delta<1.

Within each experiment, the N trials are independent measurable real variables, bounded in [0,1] almost surely, and all have expectation p(w). Indicators of successful word observations are a special case.
No cross-experiment independence. Hentry, Gentry and bentry map every desired table entry to a selected experiment.
Inputs p(w) represent the actual selected-word success probabilities; known reset and prescribed intervention law justify these expectations in an application.
dependency_graph: Pinned mathlib Hoeffding lemma bounds each centered [0,1] trial by subGaussian proxy 1/4.
Independence preserved by centering; summing N proxies gives N/4.
Chernoff bounds for sum and its negative at threshold N*epsilon give 2*exp(-2N*epsilon^2).
Finite union over M experiments requires no dependence assumptions across different words.
Radius algebra makes 2M*exp(-2N*epsilon_N^2)=delta; measurable bad-event complement gives simultaneous good-event probability at least 1-delta.
On that same good event, entrywise matrix error <=epsilon bounds each row by Cauchy-Schwarz and yields actual Euclidean operator norm <=r*epsilon; vector sum-of-squares yields sqrt(r)*epsilon.
Coverage maps instantiate every H/G_s/b0 entry on the same event.

obligation_matrix.obligation: Constants 1/4, N/4, 2N, 2M and radius logarithm are consistent with the exact mathlib MGF convention.
The two-sided bound includes both tails; good event uses <=epsilon and complement uses >epsilon.
Measurability and probability-one total mass justify taking the complement.
No independence across experiments is smuggled into the union bound.
Actual matrix spectral norm is the norm of A.toEuclideanLin.toContinuousLinearMap on EuclideanSpace, not an entrywise substitute.
Zero rank r=0 gives legitimate zero norms; repeated coverage-map words are allowed; M=0 and N=0 are excluded by the natural formula domain.

residual_limits: No validity for one dependent trajectory, post-selected experiments, unknown resets, adaptive stopping, or distribution drift without new assumptions.
No rank, gap or model-class coverage guarantee follows from concentration alone.
The monograph should state M>=1 and N>=1 explicitly; Lean already enforces these natural domains.
